title: Bolder directions for design-system.wpei.me
question: Foreign forms at full commitment, each still built around a working record demo from your reference. The first card was dealt to lead. Pick one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: The Crank Procession
options.thesis: One record walks a procession of disclosure states, row, hover card, peek, loading, no access, driven by a single crank the visitor turns by pointer or arrow keys.
materials: cut white paper on grey board
options.viewport: Heavy caps headline top left, a test strip of the five states top right, and below a full-width procession of paper record figures riding one crank line; the crimson crank and Watch on GitHub are the only colour.
options.risk: The automaton reading turns playful if the figures are not real, readable record UI at working size.

raised.raise: A test strip shows all five states side by side, so the visitor previews each before cranking to it.
A small honest counter states what exists today: 0 registry items, docs in progress, Base UI only.
Each state lands once with one settle and then holds still; nothing loops.

options.label: Layered Papercut
options.thesis: Disclosure as cut layers pasted over each other: row on top, hover card, peek and side panel beneath; depth comes only from overlap, never shading.
options.viewport: Headline left on near-black; right a large roundel of five grey layers, the row on top, each layer labelled; lifting a layer exposes the one below intact.
options.case: Holds product clarity (removing a layer leaves the one below intact, which is progressive disclosure) but developers identify with it less than with the crank's record procession.
options.risk: Becomes an ornament if the layers stop being real record surfaces.

options.label: Passport Data Page
options.lineage: passport data pages, entry stamps and machine-readable zones
options.thesis: Permission-shaped data as clearance: each state is a stamp on the record's page, and each stamp names the rule that issued it.
options.viewport: An open booklet: the left data page holds the headline, purpose, Watch on GitHub and a machine-readable zone; the right page carries five state stamps, each citing its source.
options.case: Holds audience identification for permission-heavy apps, but states as stamps say less about rows, cards and rails than the crank does.
options.risk: Burgundy-and-gold passport clichés creep in; this stays grey security paper with one blue action.

options.label: Darkroom Safelight
options.thesis: Data develops into view through fixed stations.
options.viewport: A print emerging in the developer tray.
options.case: Amber ground breaks monochrome-plus-one-accent, and it covers only the loading state.
options.risk: One state stretched into a whole site.

options.label: Minihompy Room
options.thesis: The system as a room you furnish with components.
options.viewport: An isometric room furnished with components.
options.case: Pastel palette breaks the brand and the audience does not read data rules as decoration.

options.label: Spy Dossier Titles
options.thesis: Records as surveillance frames stamped classified.
options.viewport: A reticle sweeping a frame grid.
options.case: Surveillance framing misstates what disclosure rules are for, and manila breaks monochrome.
options.kept: A state lands once, then holds still.

canonCard.label: The category standard (shadcn/ui, Geist, Base UI)
canonCard.thesis: A centred launch page at the craft of ui.shadcn.com, vercel.com/geist and base-ui.com.
canonCard.viewport: A centred badge, headline, purpose line and GitHub button, with three rule-area cards below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other shadcn registries by design.
